page.description: Agents installed on the device open here over HTTPS, behind this app's sign-in.

installed.containersStopped: The device reports this agent's containers have stopped unexpectedly. Start it again, or Stop to reset it.

store.heading: Agent store: run on the device
store.allInstalled: Every web agent from the store is already installed.

desktop.heading: Agent store: run on your computer
desktop.description: These agents run on a computer and use the device's OpenAI-compatible API. Point them at the device (for example http://<device address>/v1) with the key from tiiny auth key.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.text: This removes the agent from the device. You can install it again from the agent store.

page.title: Connectors
page.description: Email, calendars, messaging and MCP tools that models can use in Task mode.

services.heading: Services
services.description: Models use connected services in Task mode, within what you authorize. Connections live on the device and are shared with TiinyOS.
services.waitingForSignIn: Waiting for you to finish signing in… <link>Open the sign-in page</link>

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect?
disconnectDialog.text: Disconnect {{name}}? The device forgets the stored sign-in, and models can no longer use it.

connect.title: Connect {{name}}
connect.telegramIntro: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram (/newbot) and paste the token it gives you.
connect.discordIntro: Create a bot in the Discord Developer Portal, turn on Message Content Intent, invite it to your server and paste its token.
connect.xIntro: Sign in to x.com in a browser and copy the auth_token and ct0 cookies.
connect.channelIdHelp: The channel the bot may read and post in.
connect.whatsappIntro: In WhatsApp on your phone open Settings → Linked devices → Link a device, and scan this code.
connect.emailIntro: Use an app password (Gmail, Outlook and iCloud require one when two-step sign-in is on).

mcp.heading: Custom MCP servers
mcp.description: Tools from these servers are offered to models in Task mode. They run on the device.

removeDialog.title: Remove MCP server?
removeDialog.text: Remove {{name}} from the device? Models can no longer use its tools.

addDialog.title: Add an MCP server
addDialog.description: The server runs on the device, so it must be reachable from there. Servers that need a desktop or a browser will not work on the device.
addDialog.name: Name

page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: The device's own settings, as in TiinyOS.

personalization.title: Personalization
personalization.subheader: Context the device gives models about you in Task mode
personalization.saved: Saved. Models see it from the next Task mode conversation.

autoPowerOn.title: Auto power-on
autoPowerOn.description: The device turns on by itself when connected to power. The device does not report whether this is on (it always reads as off), so only the result of a change is shown.

update.title: System update
update.confirmText: Models stop and the device restarts during the installation. Don't unplug it until it is back.
update.installing: Installing the update. The device restarts once; don't unplug it.

power.title: Power
power.restarting: Restarting… waiting for the device to come back.
power.notBack: The device has not come back after 10 minutes
power.restartText: Loaded models, chats and agents stop, and the device is unreachable for a few minutes.
power.shutDownText: Loaded models, chats and agents stop. The device stays off until it is turned on at the device (or reconnected to power with Auto power-on).

apiAccess.title: API access
apiAccess.subheader: Use the device's models from other apps on your network
apiAccess.hint: Use a model id from the Models page, or default for the model most recently used. Keep the key private: anyone with it can use the device's API.

storage.title: Storage
storage.deleteModelText: Delete {{id}} from the device? You will have to download it again to use it.
storage.deleteAgentText: Delete {{id}} and its data from the device? This cannot be undone.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.subheader: Chat history and Vault, saved to this computer

restore.failed: The device could not restore the backup
restore.confirmText: Replace {{categories}} on the device with the backup's contents? What was added since the backup is lost.

network.title: Network
network.subheader: Wi-Fi and wired connections of the device
network.wifiLink: This app reaches the device over Wi-Fi ({{interface}}), so turning Wi-Fi off, forgetting {{ssid}} or joining another network is disabled here. Use TiinyOS or connect the device by cable to make those changes.

forgetDialog.title: Forget network?
forgetDialog.text: The device will forget {{ssid}} and its password.

pages.store: Models from the Tiiny store. Downloads go to the device; load them from the Models tab.
